description: Atlas is a searchable directory of ChatGPT and Claude apps. Ask for apps by category, use case, or keyword and Atlas returns a clean table of matching results so you can compare options at a glance. It is useful for developers scouting the landscape, users looking for the right tool for a task, and anyone curious about what AI-native apps exist today. Atlas does not cover general software outside the ChatGPT and Claude ecosystems, does not handle app installation or purchases, and does not serve intents related to building, coding, or configuring apps.
